<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are all except the carbonyl‑like signal at 166.40 ppm and the aliphatic signal at 52.24 ppm. That leaves 16 distinct carbon signals, representing 16 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>16</final_answer>
